name: parse-address Shapes
description: Address shapes taken from parse-address's test suite (github.com/hassansin/parse-address, ISC licence), whose cases largely descend from the Perl module Geo::StreetAddress::US, plus the few shapes only that module's suite exercises. Only the shapes are taken: every input here is original, written for this corpus, with its own street names, numbers and towns. address-plus is a drop-in for parse-address, so these shapes are the compatibility bar. The intersection shapes are left out; parseIntersection has its own suite.
